for p in ['*', '//', '/a b', '/a\tb', '/a%2', '/a%zz', '/a%', '/a\\b', '/a#frag',
          '', '/\xe9', '/a\x00', 'http://x/', 'http:x', './a', '/a?', '/a?"', '/a[', '/a]',
          '/a<', '/a>', '/a"', '/a{', '/a|', '/a}', '/a^', '/a`', '/a\x7f', '/a\x01',
          '/a//b'.replace('/a//b','/x')]:
    expect_reject(F(path=p, authority='demo.test', scheme='https'))
expect_reject(F(method='GET', path='*', authority='demo.test', scheme='https'))
expect_reject(F(method='POST', path='*', authority='demo.test', scheme='https'))
expect_fwd(F(method='OPTIONS', path='*', authority='demo.test', scheme='https'))
expect_fwd(F(method='OPTIONS', path='/x', authority='demo.test', scheme='https'))
